ticket.title: Publish an independent models-catalog crate (models.dev + curated Cline feed)
ticket.description: DONE: published as models-catalog 0.1.0 on crates.io (repo colinwolff/models-catalog, MIT OR Apache-2.0, edition 2024, MSRV 1.85). Verified against the constraints recorded when this ticket was filed: pure-sync core available with default-features = false plus the bundled snapshot (no runtime, no network, no disk); reqwest/tokio/directories/flate2/clap/rand all optional behind reqwest-client, disk-spool, bundled and cli features; injectable spool dir with no forced global singleton; upstream parity harness documented in docs/NORMALIZATION_AND_PARITY.md. It also ships two things the suite needs and did not plan for: resolve_gateway_max_output_tokens (the 32k cap, 1,024 reserve and reasoning floor) and a requires_streaming flag from the curated overlay. Integration tracked in GB-217.
acceptance_criteria: Published to crates.io with a version that can be depended on
Offline/sync path needs no runtime, network or disk

task.title: Publish an independent models-catalog crate (models.dev + curated Cline feed)
task.description:
EXTERNAL DELIVERABLE, owned outside the meta-harness. A published crate that parses https://models.dev/api.json and the curated Cline feed, so the suite stops hand-declaring limits and stops scraping docs for the ClinePass set. Consumed later by GB-217.

Confirmed inputs (measured): models.dev/api.json answers 200 in ~1.1s, 5.9MB, 233 providers, carries limit.context/limit.input/limit.output plus reasoning_options, and includes a cline-pass provider with 18 entries. The curated feed https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/ai/cline/recommended-models answers 200 with {recommended, free, clinePass, clineCloud} and 15 clinePass ids including the exact wire id in use.

INTEGRATION CONSTRAINTS, each with the reason it matters:
1. Core is offline: pure parse/lookup with no runtime and no I/O; fetching behind a feature. The suite Tier 2/3 gates must never touch the network.
2. The curated feed is undocumented and advisory, never a hard dependency: last-known snapshot wins, absence degrades to no answer. Entitlement drives a label, never a spend gate.
3. Cache directory and single-flight coalescing are injected, not ambient: no hardcoded cache path, no process-wide singleton, so tests stay deterministic and nothing collides with the canonical .gaugeblock directory.
4. Bundle a trimmed snapshot (id -> limits/efforts/modalities), not the raw 5.9MB payload, so offline and CI users get stable data.
5. Return facts, not policy: normalisation and lookup live in the crate; the choice of budget and effort stays in sawhorse where the contracts and tests are. Successor rule for the suite is config override > catalog > default.
6. Do not model provider config (base URLs, auth env names, fallbacks); ProviderConfig owns those and duplication drifts. Expose limits, modalities, effort options, curated membership.
7. Suite-compatible hygiene: edition 2024, thiserror, no unwrap in library paths, files under 250 lines.

The parity harness belongs here as a scheduled job comparing upstream schema keys, failing only when keys disappear rather than when models are added.
